runtime.listLimit: admin revision list clamps request limit by maxListRows
runtime.adminContentFilter: revision admin page can filter bounded history by contentId
runtime.requestLimit: admin restore rejects request bodies beyond maxRequestBytes before JSON parse
runtime.adminStats: revision.stats returns revision totals, distinct content count, actionStats and statusStats for admin diagnostics
runtime.adminStatsUi: ability page renders revision totals, action aggregates and status aggregates as tables, while retaining raw JSON for diagnostics
runtime.restoreResultUi: revision.restore returns revisionId, contentId, title, status, categoryId, isDraft and updateTime; ability page renders the restore result as a table while retaining raw JSON diagnostics
runtime.typedDiff: diff rows include fieldType, diffMode, beforeKind, afterKind, changeKind, typeChanged, beforeLength, afterLength, beforeLineCount, afterLineCount, beforeValue, and afterValue for structured rendering
runtime.numericDiff: numeric diff rows include beforeNumber, afterNumber, and numberDelta when both sides are numeric
runtime.booleanDiff: boolean diff rows include beforeBool and afterBool when both sides are booleans
runtime.datetimeDiff: date/time/datetime diff rows use diffMode=datetime and include beforeTimeText/afterTimeText for integer timestamps
runtime.enumDiff: select/radio/checkbox/checklist/combobox diff rows use diffMode=enum and include beforeLabel/afterLabel when field options resolve the stored values
runtime.relationDiff: categoryId and custom content relation diff rows use diffMode=relation and include beforeLabel/afterLabel with category title/path or content title when resolvable
runtime.customRelationDiff: custom fields using relation/reference/content component types, relationTarget=content, or *ContentId names resolve content_item titles in admin diff views
runtime.categoryBindRestoreSync: revision.restore updates content_category_bind when content.category is enabled so restore does not reintroduce legacy category_id drift
